Quirk Breakthrough.name: Quirk Breakthrough
Quirk Breakthrough.description:
🚀 Your Quirk has broken through to a new level: more power, and the control to hold it.

🔓 It unlocks your Quirk's Ultimate technique, which still needs the matching Quirk skill at 45 to learn.
📋 As a level-up pick it requires level 8 and Quirk Control 15. The story can also grant it at a turning point.
➡️ It opens the way to Quirk Awakening at level 24.
🚫 Not available to Quirkless characters.

📈 Grants: Quirk Control +5, Quirk Output +5
Quirk Breakthrough.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's Quirk has broken through to a new level. Mark the moment with a scene in which the Quirk does something it never managed before: a longer reach, a heavier blow, a sharper shape or a cleaner stop. From then on the new level is steady and reliable. It unlocks Ultimate techniques: with enough skill, the user can now learn and use their signature move. Limits: the Quirk keeps its nature and family, it gains no new kind of power, the Drawback stays, and Ultimate techniques still cost severe Strain. Teachers, rivals, agencies and villains notice the jump, and the character's registered Quirk details may need updating. If the character chose Quirkless, this trait does not apply: they have no Quirk to break through.
